questions.question: Why are wet hands dangerous around switches?
questions.explanation: Water can help current pass through the body.

questions.question: Overloading an outlet can cause
questions.explanation: Too much current can overheat wires.

questions.question: Frayed cords should be replaced or repaired safely before use.
It is safest to pull a plug out by yanking the cord.
questions.explanation: Pull by the plug, not the cord.

questions.question: Too many devices on one outlet can create an electrical ________.
questions.explanation: An overload can overheat a circuit.

questions.question: Give two household electrical safety rules and explain one reason for either rule.
questions.correctAnswer: A good answer names rules such as avoid water, avoid overloads, replace frayed cords, unplug safely.
questions.explanation: Examples: keep devices away from water because water conducts electricity; avoid overloading outlets because wires can overheat.

questions.question: Which statement best matches this lesson?
questions.explanation: The first option states a central idea from the lesson.
options: Water can conduct electricity, making wet hands and wet floors dangerous.
